decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet launched in 2024 fits the firm's core prescription offer, has its own page, and its prospects are still uncertain, so the option costs little to keep while its value resolves.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the firm's core and faces generic price pressure, but after only one year and with its own product page the uncertainty has not resolved, so keeping the low-cost option is still justified.
The combination antihypertensive is close to the firm's established offer and uses existing manufacturing capacity, so the cost of keeping it is low while its market value is still emerging.

The bone and joint supplement supports the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive health products and is cheap to keep, although its mere mention on the website suggests weaker commitment that slightly raises the drop risk.
